Cape Farewell, Greenland, in 60d30m by Munk's observation
Munckenes (Resolution Island), north side of the entrance to Fretum Christian (Hudson Strait), in 61d20m
inferred: harbour named Rin Sund among islets in Hudson Strait; meets and exchanges gifts with Inuit
inferred: mid-Hudson Strait, in 62d20m, working west toward Novum Mare
rounds Digges Eyland (Digges Island) before the three-day run south-west to Nova Dania
inferred: crossing Novum Mare (Hudson Bay) toward the Churchill River

surgeon David Velske (Lamprenen) dies; scurvy and dysentery already spreading among the crew
